title: atraphaxis frutescens
intro: Atraphaxis frutescens, commonly known as Devil's Claw, is a plant species in the family Polygonaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation and pain, improving digestion, and aiding in the management of diabetes and high blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Devil's Claw are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Devil's Claw include harpagoside, a iridoid glycoside that is responsible for its therapeutic effects.
